newsitem.title: JAPAN: Chrysler to begin new sales programme in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler to begin new sales programme in Japan.

text.p: Chrysler Corp unit Chrysler Japan Sales Ltd said on Wednesday it will launch a new programme to boost sales of Neon sedans in Japan.

It said in a statement that in the new phase of the "Neon Experience" sales drive, to be launched on Thursday, it will waive interest payments for the rest of the year for Neon buyers on a 60-month payment plan, for up to 15 percent of the price of the car. No down payment is required.
Chrysler has allocated 500 units of two types of Neon sedans for the new programme.
The LE type will be priced at 1.64 million yen and the LX type at 1.80 million yen.
"A customer can buy a Neon up to 15 percent cheaper and postpone actual spending of their own money until January next year," a company spokeswoman said.

The first phase of the sales programme was held in March under which customers, who would pay a monthly payment of 14,200 yen or 18,800 yen a month, were given the opportunity to return the vehicle after one year if they were not satisfied with it, the unit said.
The first phase resulted in 500 Neons being sold in three days, Chrysler said.
